Subject: Stakeholder map & MAP - next steps

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap from my side and proposed next steps so we keep momentum.

Call summary / stakeholders (as I heard it):
- Economic buyer: Tom Rivers (CFO) — decision maker for budget and contract
- Security lead: Alice Johnson (Head of InfoSec) — responsible for SOC2, JML, and vendor security review
- Procurement: procurement@finpay.com — handles SOW/PO and standard terms
- Technical leads: will nominate an engineer for the pilot (we discussed a short technical kickoff)

Key decision criteria you called out:
- Latency: p95 < 200ms for two production routes
- Cost: predictable unit economics (goal: <$0.50 per 1M tokens processed for batched workloads)
- Data controls: US-only residency, KMS integration, audit logs

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) milestones (draft):
1) Send MAP & stakeholder matrix (today) — owner: Marissa — ACTION: review and confirm owners/dates
2) Security review & questionnaire response — target: by 2026-11-10 — owner: Alice
3) Technical kickoff / pilot plan — target week of 2026-11-15 — owner: FinPay engineering + Redwood SE
4) Procurement/contract review & redlines — target: by 2026-11-22 — owner: Procurement / Marissa
5) Pilot execution & acceptance criteria — 2–3 week pilot after kickoff — owner: FinPay + Redwood

I've attached a draft MAP (FinPay_MAP_v1.pdf) and a simple contacts sheet (FinPay_Security_Contacts.xlsx) for you to fill in. Can you confirm:
- The stakeholder list above is correct and any owners/dates we should change
- Whether procurement needs a vendor questionnaire or any additional paperwork up front

Next steps: if you confirm these owners/dates I will finalize the MAP and share a calendar for the technical kickoff.

Best,

Adding a few technical notes from the SE perspective before the kickoff: 

1) Pilot scope & acceptance criteria (proposal):
- Ingest a representative sample (100k tokens/day) + 1 production route for p95 latency validation
- Latency: target p95 < 200ms with batch size up to 8 for interactive calls
- Metrics: token cost per 1M, p95 latency, error rate, KV cache hit rate

2) Data / access requests:
- We'll need a small sample dataset and example traffic profile (anonymized) to baseline latency/cost
- Request: an S3 or secure upload link; if you prefer not to share sample data we can run a synthetic workload but results will be approximate

3) Security & environment:
- We'll provide SOC2 links and an SSP summary in the shared drive link (Marissa, I uploaded a short SSP summary)
- For the pilot we recommend a short-lived test API key (scoped) and a dedicated test bucket for logs/audit

Availability: SE team is free for a 60–90m kickoff on Nov 16 or Nov 17 (PST) — please pick a slot and we'll send calendar invite.

Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
